name: French
notes: Native and near-native French speakers are required to consult with the Undergraduate Advisor before enrolling for the first time in any French course in order to verify placement. P/NP grading not allowed for major courses. At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major. With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.

groups.label: Preparation for the Major
groups.note: French 16A-B is an accelerated two-quarter sequence that is an option in place of French 1-3.

groups.label: Writing Requirement
groups.note: For area A, qualified students can substitute requirements with more advanced courses by petition and instructor's approval.

groups.label: Culture Requirement
groups.note: At least one French 104 course is required prior to French 101 courses.

groups.label: Upper-division courses taught in French
groups.note: 8 units from courses numbered French 105-151, or 197, 198, 199 provided all materials and assignments are completed in French.

groups.label: Additional upper-division electives
groups.note: 14 units of electives from courses numbered French 105-199, with or without 191F, or from the following courses. By petition up to 8 units from Comparative Literature can be applied to the upper-division major provided the course is taught by the faculty from the French and Italian Department.
